name: HealthJoy Behavioral Health
one_liner: Employer benefits app whose care team points you to the therapy, psychiatry, EAP counseling and self-guided programs your plan covers.
best_for: Employees whose company offers HealthJoy and who want help finding covered therapy or psychiatry
People who want a care team to sort out which mental health benefit or EAP to use
People who also want help with medical bills, in-network providers and prescriptions
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People whose employer does not offer HealthJoy (a company-sponsored membership is required)
People looking for a specific therapist or treatment program, which depends on the partners your employer chose
short_description: An employer-sponsored benefits app: a HealthJoy care team and AI assistant connect you to the mental health and EAP partners in your company's plan.
long_description: HealthJoy is a benefits navigation platform sold to employers. Employees use its app to understand their health benefits, find in-network providers, get help with bills and prescriptions, and reach a healthcare concierge team. Its care-partner list includes a mental health category ("therapy, psychiatry, and self-guided programs matched to members' needs and severity level") and an employee assistance program offering short-term counseling, referrals and resources. HealthJoy does not publish which therapy or psychiatry companies sit behind these categories; they vary with what your employer has set up. The App Store listing states that you must have a company-sponsored membership to use it. There are no published studies of HealthJoy's mental health navigation.

pricing.starting_price: Free through your employer; care costs depend on your plan
pricing.notes: Only available through a company-sponsored membership. Copays or fees for therapy, psychiatry or EAP sessions depend on the benefits your employer offers.

privacy.notes: Policy says HealthJoy does not sell personal information or share it for cross-context advertising, any user can request deletion, and it publishes a HIPAA notice of privacy practices.

faqs.a: HealthJoy Behavioral Health pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.

faqs.q: Is HealthJoy Behavioral Health covered by insurance?
faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Finding covered therapy or psychiatry through your employer
Reaching EAP short-term counseling and referrals
Getting matched to self-guided mental health programs
Help understanding and using health benefits

patient_summary: If your employer offers HealthJoy, you download the app and ask its care team or assistant to connect you with therapy, psychiatry, EAP counseling or self-guided programs included in your benefits. The app is free to you through your employer; what you pay for care depends on your plan. You can't sign up on your own without a company-sponsored membership.

availability.note: Employer benefit only: the App Store listing says you must have a company-sponsored membership.
